# heytownhall_coverage (Data Source)

The public coverage list: each jurisdiction the product reads, how much of it, and what is held now. It comes from `GET /v1/coverage`, which needs no key and is not billed, so the data source works with any valid provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "heytownhall_coverage" "bc" {
  country = "CA"
  region  = "BC"
}

output "bc_jurisdictions" {
  value = [for j in data.heytownhall_coverage.bc.jurisdictions : j.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `country` (String) Only jurisdictions in this country (a two-letter code such as `CA`).
- `kind` (String) Only jurisdictions of this kind (such as `city`).
- `region` (String) Only jurisdictions in this region (such as `BC`).

### Read-Only

- `jurisdictions` (Attributes List) The jurisdictions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jurisdictions))

<a id="nestedatt--jurisdictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jurisdictions`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Its country.
- `first_meeting_on` (String) The date of the earliest meeting.
- `held` (Map of Number) Records held now, by family.
- `id` (String) The jurisdiction's id.
- `ingest_profile` (String) How much of it is read.
- `kind` (String) What kind of body it is.
- `last_meeting_on` (String) The date of the latest meeting.
- `meeting_vendors` (List of String) The meeting platforms it is read from.
- `meetings` (Number) Meetings held.
- `name` (String) Its name.
- `read_at` (String) When it was last read (RFC 3339).
- `region` (String) Its region.
